issues.description: Code defines DEFAULT_SLACK_COEFFICIENT = 3L and returns it as elasticity/target divisor, whereas spec defines ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER = 2. If targetGasUsed is derived as gas_limit // slack coefficient, all base-fee calculations will use gas_limit//3 instead of gas_limit//2.
issues.potential_impact: Consensus failure: different gas target produces different base_fee_per_gas trajectory and different block validity vs spec-compliant clients. Chain split and incorrect fee market behavior.
issues.spec_reference: ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER = 2 and Block field comment: gas_limit is the gas_target * ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER
issues.suggestion: Change DEFAULT_SLACK_COEFFICIENT to 2 to match ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER = 2, and ensure targetGasUsed = parent_gas_limit // 2 (except fork-block special case).

verification.matched_excerpt: gas_limit: int = 0 # note the gas_limit is the gas_target * ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER

issues.description: Code enforces an extra 7 wei minimum fee (baseFeeFloor = 7 unless initial is zero) via satisfiesFloorTxFee checking txn gasPrice/maxFee >= 7. Spec has no floor; only validity rule is transaction.max_fee_per_gas >= block.base_fee_per_gas, and base fee can decay to 0/1.
issues.potential_impact: Over-strict validation: valid transactions with max_fee >= base_fee but < 7 wei rejected, and if used for block validation mempool/block import diverges from spec causing consensus split or censorship of low-fee transactions.
issues.suggestion: Remove the 7-wei floor check. Validate only against the block header base_fee_per_gas as per spec.

issues.description: Code allows initial base fee to be overridden via Optional<Wei> baseFeePerGasOverride defaulting to GenesisConfig.BASEFEE_AT_GENESIS_DEFAULT_VALUE, rather than fixed INITIAL_BASE_FEE = 1000000000. On fork block computeBaseFee returns getInitialBasefee() which may not equal 1e9.
issues.potential_impact: If override != 1e9, fork-block base_fee validation differs from spec (expected_base_fee_per_gas = INITIAL_BASE_FEE), causing consensus failure at fork activation.
issues.spec_reference: INITIAL_BASE_FEE = 1000000000; if INITIAL_FORK_BLOCK_NUMBER == block.number: expected_base_fee_per_gas = INITIAL_BASE_FEE
issues.suggestion: Fix initial base fee to Uint(1000000000) for mainnet fork activation, or explicitly document override as non-consensus test-only path and enforce 1e9 when validating against EIP-1559.

issues.description: Function divides by targetGasUsed with no zero guard and does not enforce spec gas-limit rules (block.gas_limit >= 5000 and parent +/- 1/1024 change, plus fork-block doubling logic parent_gas_limit * ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER). Fork-diff calculate_base_fee_per_gas calls check_gas_limit; this file delegates to gasLimitValidationMode() with no visible logic.
issues.potential_impact: Division-by-zero panic on targetGasUsed==0 and risk that gas-limit validation is missing or incorrect elsewhere, allowing invalid blocks or client crash.
issues.spec_reference: assert block.gas_limit >= 5000; assert block.gas_limit < parent_gas_limit + parent_gas_limit // 1024; assert block.gas_limit > parent_gas_limit - parent_gas_limit // 1024
issues.suggestion: Add explicit targetGasUsed != 0 guard and enforce minimum gas limit and 1/1024 delta, including fork-block special case where parent_gas_limit = parent.gas_limit * ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER.

verification.matched_excerpt: assert block.gas_limit < parent_gas_limit + parent_gas_limit // 1024, 'invalid block: gas limit increased too much'

summary: Core base-fee up/down formula matches spec including max(...,1) on increase, but critical consensus parameters deviate: slack/elasticity is 3 vs required 2, an extra 7-wei fee floor is enforced, and initial base fee is configurable vs fixed 1e9. Gas-limit validation is not enforced in this file, risking consensus divergence.
